name: P06 child walk-in each door cleanly

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const out=[];for(const D of window.__rooms){__DQ.teleport('meadow');await sleep(900);const d=window.__doors[D.plot];__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',d.x,d.z);await sleep(1600);const deg=d.facing*180/Math.PI;__DQ.face(deg);__DQ.cameraOrbit(deg+180);await sleep(500);for(let leg=0;leg<5&&__DQ.state().map.id==='puddlewick';leg++){__DQ.hold('up',1400);await sleep(1800);}const went=__DQ.state().map.id;out.push({plot:D.plot,want:D.room,went,ok:went===D.room});if(went!==D.room&&went!=='puddlewick'){__DQ.teleport('meadow');await sleep(800);}}window.__IN=out;return JSON.stringify(out);})()

steps.note: walk out each room after teleport in

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const out=[];for(const D of window.__rooms){__DQ.teleport('meadow');await sleep(700);__DQ.teleport(D.room);await sleep(1400);for(let k=0;k<20&&__DQ.state().scene!=='field';k++){__DQ.press('confirm');await sleep(350);}__DQ.face(0);__DQ.cameraOrbit(180);await sleep(300);for(let leg=0;leg<5&&__DQ.state().map.id===D.room;leg++){__DQ.hold('up',1600);await sleep(2000);}if(__DQ.state().map.id===D.room){__DQ.press('confirm');await sleep(1000);}out.push({room:D.room,landed:__DQ.state().map.id,ok:__DQ.state().map.id==='puddlewick'});}window.__OUT=out;return JSON.stringify(out);})()
